CIT_META_2022.title: A 2022 Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Enriched Therapeutic Diets and Nutraceuticals in Canine and Feline Osteoarthritis
CIT_META_2022.notes: Systematic review/meta-analysis; reported clearer analgesic efficacy for omega-3 and a marked non-effect for chondroitin-glucosamine nutraceuticals.

CIT_GC_2007.title: Randomised double-blind, positive-controlled trial to assess the efficacy of glucosamine/chondroitin sulfate for the treatment of dogs with osteoarthritis
CIT_GC_2007.notes: Older canine trial reported improvements with glucosamine/chondroitin versus positive control context.

CIT_OMEGA_2010_1.title: Evaluation of the effects of dietary supplementation with fish oil omega-3 fatty acids on weight bearing in dogs with osteoarthritis
CIT_OMEGA_2010_1.notes: Randomized double-blinded controlled clinical trial in client-owned dogs.

CIT_OMEGA_2010_2.title: Multicenter veterinary practice assessment of the effects of omega-3 fatty acids on osteoarthritis in dogs
CIT_OMEGA_2010_2.notes: Randomized double-blinded controlled multicenter clinical trial.

CIT_GLM_2003.title: Influence of green lipped mussels (Perna canaliculus) in alleviating signs of arthritis in dogs
CIT_GLM_2003.notes: Double-blind clinical study reported improvements in total arthritis score and some joint signs.

CIT_GLM_2009.title: Evaluating Complementary Therapies for Canine Osteoarthritis Part I: Green-lipped Mussel (Perna canaliculus)

CIT_UCII_2019.title: Evaluation of the Effects of Undenatured Type II Collagen (UC-II) as Compared to Robenacoxib on the Mobility Impairment Induced by Osteoarthritis in Dogs
CIT_UCII_2019.notes: Randomized controlled prospective study; positive mobility findings, with important design and comparator limitations.

CIT_UCII_BOS_2024.title: Effects of a feed supplement, containing undenatured type II collagen (UC II) and Boswellia Serrata, in the management of mild/moderate mobility disorders in dogs
CIT_UCII_BOS_2024.notes: Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled cross-over trial of a combination formula.

CIT_EGG_2019.title: Placebo-controlled pilot study of the effects of an eggshell membrane-based supplement on mobility and serum biomarkers in dogs with osteoarthritis
CIT_EGG_2019.notes: Small pilot trial; authors noted results were not definitive.

CIT_EGG_2025.title: Efficacy of a joint supplement containing eggshell membrane among other ingredients to improve the mobility of dogs with osteoarthritis
CIT_EGG_2025.notes: Randomized placebo-controlled trial of a multi-ingredient supplement, so effects cannot be assigned to eggshell membrane alone.

CIT_BOS_CUR_2021.title: Clinical efficacy of Curcuvet and Boswellic acid combined with conventional nutraceutical product: An aid to canine osteoarthritis
CIT_BOS_CUR_2021.notes: Small randomized study of combination therapy; does not isolate Boswellia or curcumin.

CIT_TURMERIC_2003.title: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled parallel group study of P54FP for the treatment of dogs with osteoarthritis
CIT_TURMERIC_2003.notes: Trial of a specific turmeric extract preparation; applicability to generic turmeric products is limited.

CIT_MULTI_2022.title: Efficacy of a dietary supplement in dogs with osteoarthritis: A randomized placebo-controlled, double-blind clinical trial
CIT_MULTI_2022.notes: Positive trial of a multi-ingredient formula; cannot attribute outcomes to individual ingredients.

CIT_ASU_2009.title: Protective effects of total fraction of avocado/soybean unsaponifiables on the structural changes in experimental dog osteoarthritis
CIT_ASU_2009.notes: Experimental induced-OA dog model, not a client-owned clinical outcomes trial.
